title: Affine rescaling of C^1 weak solutions of divergence-form systems
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and L := L(R^n, R^l). Let a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L) and w : R^n -> R^l. Let U be an open subset of R^n, y, z0 in R^n, and rho > 0, r real with B_{rho r}(y + rho z0) contained in U. Assume w is C^1 on U, and that the integral over U of a(x)[Dw(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over U of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta in U (Bochner integrals, no integrability assumed). Put wt(z) := w(y + rho z). Then: (i) wt is C^1 on B_r(z0); (ii) Dwt(z) = rho Dw(y + rho z) for z in B_r(z0); (iii) for every C^1 compactly supported zeta with tsupport zeta in B_r(z0), the integral over B_r(z0) of a(y + rho z)[Dwt(z)][Dzeta(z)] equals the integral over B_r(z0) of (rho Phi(y + rho z))[Dzeta(z)].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (y z₀ : Rn n) (ρ r : ℝ), 0 < ρ → IsOpen U → ball (y + ρ • z₀) (ρ * r) ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) (ball z₀ r) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball z₀ r, fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) z = ρ • fderiv ℝ w (y + ρ • z)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball z₀ r → ∫ z in ball z₀ r, a (y + ρ • z) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = ∫ z in ball z₀ r, (ρ • Φ (y + ρ • z)) (fderiv ℝ ζ z)
